list: The official 55 trophies, as PlayStation publishes them (names, descriptions and grades via Exophase and PSNProfiles, 2026-11-18). Counts are the targets the official descriptions state. Hidden flags mark the story and secret trophies, the ones PlayStation hides until earned. Every guide below is written for this entry from the official description alone: where the description does not pin down a place or a step, the guide says so instead of inventing one.

trophies.guide: The platinum lands on its own once the other 54 trophies are earned. Use the roadmap: finish the story first, then work the one-chance moments, then the collectibles and the long grinds last, so nothing is left behind.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide from the official description.

trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, to its end. It is the first story mission, so it comes naturally at the start of the game; there is nothing to prepare for, just follow the mission through.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase; guide from the official description.

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1. Chapter trophies unlock in story order, so keep playing the main missions until the chapter closes; do the one-chance moments flagged in this chapter before moving on, because the chapter will not come back.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase; guide from the official description.

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 2. Same rule as Chapter 1: play the story missions in order until the chapter ends, and clear any flagged one-chance moments in this chapter first.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase; guide from the official description.

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 3. By now the story is opening up Vice City itself; keep to the main missions until the chapter closes and mop up this chapter's flagged moments before the next one starts.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase; guide from the official description.

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 4. This is the last full chapter before the finale, so it is the last chance for any chapter-flagged moment; finish the chapter's story missions in order and check the missable list before the finale begins.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase; guide from the official description.

trophies.guide: Play and finish the final mission of the story. Do every other story-flagged trophy first: once the final mission is done the story is over, and anything tied to an earlier chapter may be out of reach.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase; guide from the official description.

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Breakfast Run when it appears in your mission list. Named-mission trophies unlock by playing that mission to completion; take it as soon as it is offered so it is not left behind when the story moves on.
trophies.name: Trust
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase; guide from the official description.

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission The Cartel Heist. Heist missions are usually the big set-pieces of their chapter, so come prepared with weapons and armour, play the mission through, and do not skip its setup steps.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase; guide from the official description.

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Child's Play when it is offered. Like the other named missions, it unlocks by completing that mission; play it as soon as it appears rather than leaving story missions stacked up.
trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase; guide from the official description.

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Headliners. The name suggests a big public moment in the story; play the mission through to its end and the trophy follows.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase; guide from the official description.

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission VCIA Takedown, the airport takedown. Expect a fight at the airport; complete the mission objectives in order and the trophy unlocks at the end.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase; guide from the official description.

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Operation Savage Glory. The name points to a military-style operation; play it through to completion when it is offered, before the story moves past it.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase; guide from the official description.

trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the in-game completion checklist: story missions, stranger strands, collectibles, activities and the counted challenges. This is a late-game trophy by design — track it in the pause menu, finish the story and the collectibles first, then clear whatever categories are still short.
trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide from the official description.

trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts — jumps, near misses, long airtime and the like — across the game. Stunts count as you play, so drive fast and take ramps whenever you travel; for the last stretch, chain stunt jumps in open areas rather than grinding one spot. The counter is cumulative, so it can be finished after the story.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide from the official description.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all 9 activity types once each — racing, fishing, shooting range, drone racing, arcade games, bowling, meditation, hunting and the rest of the open-world activities. You only need one try of each, so sample every activity icon on the map as you find it instead of mastering any one of them.
trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide from the official description.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Visit the shooting range, work through the challenges weapon by weapon, and replay any that fall short of gold — the range can be revisited after the story, so take your time and learn each challenge's target pattern before chasing gold.
trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide from the official description.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Find each drone-race spot on the map, learn its course with a practice run, then race to win; every location counts separately, so check them off one by one rather than repeating a favourite.
trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide from the official description.

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — each race only counts once, so you need 20 distinct wins. Work through the race list across the map, pick a fast car you handle well, and do not re-run a race you have already won; new race locations are what move the counter.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide from the official description.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal at a fishing spot, accept his challenge, and out-fish him — steady reeling and watching the line matter more than speed. If you lose, challenge him again; the trophy needs one win.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide from the official description.

trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game at an arcade machine. Any arcade game counts, so pick the one you find easiest, play it to its end, and the trophy unlocks — you do not need a high score, just a completion.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide from the official description.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's final mission. Character mission strands end with a last mission that only appears after you have done Andy's earlier ones, so work through his strand as it opens and take the finale when it is offered — after it, his strand is done.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase; guide from the official description.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's final mission. Same pattern as the other character finales: complete Kenton's earlier missions first, then take his last mission when it appears. The name hints at a boat, so expect it on the water.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase; guide from the official description.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's final mission. Work through Billy's strand in order and take the finale when it is offered; the title suggests a solo ride, so expect to be on your own for this one.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase; guide from the official description.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full stranger mission strands across Leonida. Strangers appear as map markers; each strand is several missions, so pick a strand, see it through to its end, and repeat until 8 are done. Strands stay available after the story, so this is safe to finish in cleanup.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide from the official description.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's final mission. Complete Randy's earlier missions first, then take his finale when it appears — the name points to a supply deal, so expect a delivery or a deal gone wrong.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase; guide from the official description.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's final mission. As with the other character finales, clear Tyrone's earlier missions in order and take the last one when it is offered; after it, his strand is closed.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase; guide from the official description.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida. Spots are scattered around the map; visit each one and meditate there. Keep a checklist as you go, because the spots are easy to lose track of — this is a cleanup trophy, best done with the map after the story.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide from the official description.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for. Take Bret's hunting mission, follow the trail to the animal he describes, and take it down — it is a specific animal, not any hunt, so follow Bret's lead rather than hunting at random.
trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide from the official description.

trophies.guide: Complete 3 full collectible card sets. Cards are hidden around Leonida; collect every card in a set to complete it, and do that for three sets. This is a long cleanup job — gather cards as you travel, then sweep the remaining spots after the story.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide from the official description.

trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 different locations. The count is per location, so spread it out: use it at a new spot each time you arrive somewhere fresh instead of repeating one place. It builds up naturally across a full playthrough plus cleanup.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide from the official description.

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges from the game's challenge list. Challenges cover driving, combat, exploration and more; open the challenge list, pick the easiest ones first, and let the rest accumulate as you play. Fifty is a lot, so treat it as a post-story cleanup target.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide from the official description.

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose the cops and escape. Do it deliberately: commit crimes with your partner in the car or on foot until you hit 4 stars, then break line of sight and stay out of the search area until the wanted level clears. Point of no return: your partner must be with you when it happens.
trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide from the official description.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row without the wanted level dropping in between. Plan a route past three close shops, keep the heat on through all three robberies, and do not let the cops lose you mid-run. If the wanted level clears, the chain breaks and you start over.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide from the official description.

trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. Every new vehicle you drive or encounter counts, so drive something different whenever you can and explore car parks, streets and the countryside. The counter climbs across the whole game, so this is a passive cleanup trophy.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide from the official description.

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down 5 enemies during one single use of Combat Focus. Set it up where enemies cluster: get five or more in view, trigger Combat Focus, and drop all five before it ends. If you run out of targets mid-focus, pull back and try again in a bigger fight.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide from the official description.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Leave the airport (VCIA) in a way that is not a scheduled flight — take a plane and go, without booking or boarding normally. Head to the airport, get into a plane on the runway or tarmac, and take off yourself; the trophy is about the unscheduled exit, not the destination.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide from the official description.

trophies.guide: The description is a joke about Rhino tanks, and it gives no step-by-step: Rhinos are the game's tanks. When tanks appear — during a high wanted level or a story moment — engage them rather than running, and see the encounter through. Do not go hunting for a tank spawn the description does not promise; take the moment when the game hands it to you.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide from the official description.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet: move slowly, avoid cameras and staff sightlines, take the goods and leave before anyone raises the alarm. If you are spotted, the attempt fails — back out, lose any attention, and try again.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide from the official description.

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time. Plan each robbery: get in, crack the vault, and get out clean before the response arrives. You need five separate successful escapes, so treat each one as its own job and do not rush the getaway.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide from the official description.

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Ambush a truck on the road, stop it, take the cash, and lose the wanted level that follows. Pick a quiet stretch of road so the getaway is clean, and have a fast car ready before you strike.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide from the official description.

trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. Drive and walk into every named area on the map until each one registers; the count is what matters, so use the map to find the areas you have not visited yet and sweep them after the story.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide from the official description.

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Find each gang's operation, rob it, and move on to the next gang — nine gangs, nine robberies. Keep track of which gangs you have hit so none is missed.
trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide from the official description.

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail at a spot with a view on Ocean Beach. Find a bar or vendor on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail, and enjoy it looking out at the water. A quiet, specific moment — do it when you are next on the beach rather than leaving it for later.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide from the official description.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom, in classic style — drive a car straight through the showroom glass and out. Pick a showroom, get a car inside or pointed at the front, and drive out through the window; the trophy is the exit, so commit to it.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide from the official description.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. Go to that alley, bowl a game, and follow through — the trophy is about playing there, so finish your game at that specific alley rather than any other lane.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide from the official description.

trophies.guide: The description gives no concrete step — it points at a partnership moment that lands with the public. Keep playing the story with your partner and watch for a scene or activity where the two of you draw a crowd; it is a story beat, not a grind, so do not try to force it in free roam.
trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide from the official description.

trophies.guide: Make choices — PSN tracks them up to 500. Choices come up in dialogue and in missions across the whole game; pick an option whenever one is offered instead of staying silent or defaulting. It is a long count, so let it build across the playthrough and check the tally in cleanup.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide from the official description.

trophies.guide: Succeed on a second try after failing once. The shape of it is a failed attempt followed by a success, so when something goes wrong, retry it right away instead of reloading an old save — the trophy is about the comeback, not a perfect run.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide from the official description.

trophies.guide: Witness something strange — the description is deliberately vague, and there is no step to invent. Keep playing and exploring, and do not rush past odd scenes, strange encounters or unexplained moments; this trophy is a 'you had to be there' beat that triggers when you see it.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide from the official description.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone over with a melee drive-by — swing a melee weapon from a moving vehicle and bowl your target over. Line up a slow pass next to a pedestrian, swing as you pass, and keep moving; a drive-by only counts while the vehicle is moving.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide from the official description.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists; pass them to your contacts to clean them, and the cleaned total adds up toward $250,000. Keep laundering after every big score instead of letting marked cash pile up.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide from the official description.

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Buy weapons, clothes, cars and upgrades as you play; the total is cumulative across every shop, so it grows on its own through a full playthrough. Save the big purchases — cars and property-adjacent spending — for when you are close to the target.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide from the official description.

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties. Garages are bought around the map; save up, visit each for-sale garage, and buy it. With eight to find, check the map for property markers you have not bought yet and finish them in cleanup.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide from the official description.

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find ten different vehicles, open the Scooter Bros app, and register each one. Any ten count, so use the vehicles you meet on the road and register them as you go.
trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles; guide from the official description.
